title: Money shows as $1,234.56 and negatives as $-12.00
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • One customer's Total is negative (more credit than invoices).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Read an amount over $1,000.
  4. Read the negative Total.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 3:

  • dollar sign, thousands comma and two decimals, for example "$1,234.56".

Step 4:

  • the minus sign follows the dollar sign, for example "$-12.00".

Why this matters: Users compare these figures by eye with QuickBooks.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/utils/reporting.ts:9-11. V1 code, quoted: ``$${formatNumber(row[prop])}``

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-053) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.

AUTOMATION: READY
